headline.en: Gavi hurt his knee at Elche and missed Saturday training
headline.es: Gavi se toco la rodilla en Elche y no entrenó el sabado

summary.en: Gavi went off at Elche with a knee problem. Flick said the first reading was less serious than it looked. Gavi still missed the Athletic match and Saturday's session. Pedri started in midfield.
summary.es: Gavi se retiro en Elche. No jugo contra el Athletic ni entrenó el sabado. Pedri cubrio el medio.

body.en: Gavi left the Elche match with pain in his knee. Flick said afterwards that it looked less serious than first thought and that a scan would confirm it. The club has not published a long injury bulletin. Gavi did not play against Athletic. He was not in Saturday's full session. Pedri started that midfield role and can start against Rayo. Rodri is still on a gym plan. If both stay on reduced work, Flick has fewer midfield options for the first European week. Until a new medical note appears, this is availability news. Gavi is being managed. He is not confirmed out for a long spell.

headline.en: Gordon cost 70 million plus add-ons. Adeyemi cost 22 million plus add-ons
headline.es: Gordon costo 70 millones mas variables. Adeyemi, 22 millones mas variables

summary.en: Culemania said Barcelona paid Newcastle 70 million plus 10 million in add-ons for Gordon and Dortmund 22 million plus seven million for Adeyemi. Rodri cost more than 70 million. Cancelo arrived free. Academy sales this week help the 1:1 ratio.
summary.es: 70 mas 10 por Gordon. 22 mas siete por Adeyemi. Rodri mas de 70. Cancelo libre.

body.en: Barcelona spent heavily after returning to the 1:1 salary rule. Gordon was 70 million euros plus 10 million in add-ons. Adeyemi was 22 million plus seven million. Rodri was more than 70 million. Cancelo arrived free from Al Hilal. Sales of academy players this week, including Fernandez and Cortes, bring in smaller sums. Those sales do not fund Rodri. They help keep the salary ratio legal so the big contracts can stay on the list. Livakovic's registration sits in the same file. If he cannot be listed, he may be loaned. Fair play is the limit on all of this.

headline.en: Joan Garcia has started both Liga games and not conceded
headline.es: Joan Garcia ha sido titular en los dos partidos y no ha encajado

summary.en: Joan Garcia started against Elche and Athletic and kept two clean sheets. Ter Stegen is on loan at Ajax. Szczesny is the backup. Livakovic has a contract to 2030 and is waiting to be registered.
summary.es: Garcia ha sido titular y no ha encajado. Ter Stegen esta en el Ajax. Livakovic espera ficha.

body.en: Joan Garcia is the starter. He has played both Liga matches and conceded no goals. Ter Stegen is at Ajax on loan. Szczesny is the experienced deputy. Livakovic signed until 2030 and trained with the group on Saturday. He is not confirmed on the Liga list. Flick has said he likes experienced goalkeepers for the coming years. That does not change Garcia's place for Rayo on Monday. Two clean sheets are a good start. They do not close the Livakovic file. Until the registration is public, Garcia starts and Livakovic waits.
